threat_event: Malicious communications through vendor remote access to a low impact substation go undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Detection method for vendor remote access in place at 22 of 58 substations
affected_asset_or_process: 58 transmission substations (low impact BES Cyber Systems)
existing_controls: Vendor sessions through the utility remote access system with MFA
treatment_plan: Detection at all 58 substations; self-report to SERC

threat_event: Loss of real-time data links with the RC or neighboring TOPs is not recovered as planned
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CIP-012-2 plan lacks availability and recovery methods
existing_controls: Confidentiality and integrity protections in place (Part 1.1)
treatment_plan: Add availability and recovery methods; update agreements with the RC and TOPs

threat_event: TCC design documents (BCSI) on the affiliate project platform are exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 of 20 sampled projects hold TCC BCSI outside the utility information protection program
existing_controls: Engineers with TCC access are in the CIP-004-7 program
treatment_plan: Move BCSI to the utility repository; authorized access lists; self-report

threat_event: Ransomware in shared IT forces the utility to cut IT links to the DCC and lose outage feeds
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DCC outage management depends on IT feeds (AMI events, customer calls)
regulatory_driver: None binding; group voluntary benchmark (CSF 2.0 RS.MI-01)
treatment_plan: Isolation runbook for the DCC; manual outage intake

threat_event: Attack on the TCC EACMS from the corporate network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Corporate network can reach the TCC Electronic Access Point (blocked by rules)
existing_controls: CIP-005-7 Electronic Access Point with deny-by-default rules; OT sensors
treatment_plan: Remove the remaining corporate route to the EAP; alerting on blocked attempts

threat_event: DOE-417 or CIP-008-6 report missed during a cross-division incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DCC staff not trained on DOE-417 cyber criteria; group matrix not exercised
treatment_plan: DOE-417 criteria checklist at the DCC; cross-division tabletop

threat_event: Storm restoration delayed because the GEPS and the affiliate storm desk are down together
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Storm stock in the GEPS; all large spares from the affiliate
treatment_plan: Offline storm stock register; joint storm drill with Manufacturing
owner: Electric Utility director of supply chain

threat_event: A compromised affiliate engineer account with TCC access is used against the TCC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 140 Grid Engineering engineers hold TCC access
existing_controls: CIP-004-7 quarterly verification; Intermediate System with MFA
treatment_plan: Reduce standing access to the engineers on active TCC projects

threat_event: Intrusion into distribution SCADA at the DCC goes undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT network sensors at the DCC
regulatory_driver: None binding; group voluntary benchmark (CSF 2.0 DE.CM-01)
treatment_plan: OT sensors at the DCC and backup DCC

threat_event: Malicious TMU firmware from the affiliate reaches the 41 substations with TMUs
treatment_plan: Verify signatures once HSM signing is live; include in CIP-013-2 vendor assessment

threat_event: Customer personal information breached at the CIS or AMI vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor SaaS holds Social Security and bank account numbers
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example)
treatment_plan: Tokenize Social Security numbers after credit checks
owner: Electric Utility vice president of customer operations

threat_event: Load-forecasting model error drives wrong day-ahead purchases or peak plans
existing_controls: Operators compare with the RC forecast
owner: Electric Utility manager of load forecasting

threat_event: Single-source dependency on the affiliate for large power transformer spares
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: All large spares from the affiliate
existing_controls: Spare sharing program with neighboring utilities
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low by the division security and compliance lead
owner: Division security and compliance lead (Electric Utility)

threat_event: Physical attack on a transmission substation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CIP-014-3 not applicable; perimeter fencing and cameras
treatment_plan: Intrusion detection at the 10 most critical substations
